request.subject: UNIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Remove the shield and the spear completely. Instead he carries one huge two-handed greatsword with a broad steel blade and gold crossguard resting on his shoulder, blade slanting up behind his head; a short crimson tabard with a gold cross over his breastplate. The kettle helmet becomes a rounded helmet with cheek guards, gold band and tall crimson plume. Keep face, plate armour, pauldrons, proportions, feet, outline and style the same, transparent background. Sun at the bottom left.
